paths.cachePlaceholder: Enter or select folder for metadata

limit.label: Storage Limit
limit.unlimitedHint: Nothing is deleted to free up space. Recording stops when the drive is almost full.
limit.limitedHint: Older sessions and replay buffers are deleted to stay under the limit.
limit.warningBody:
The storage limit ({{limit}} GB) is lower than your current folder size ({{current}} GB).

This will cause older recordings to be automatically deleted to free up space.

Are you sure you want to continue?

gameFolders.label: Save Recordings in Game Folders
gameFolders.description: Puts each recording in a folder named after the game. Changing this moves your existing recordings.

excludeClips.label: Exclude Clips and Highlights From Storage Limit
excludeClips.description: Clips and highlights are never deleted to free up space. When on, only sessions and replay buffers count toward the limit.

removeOriginal.label: Delete Original After Compression
removeOriginal.description: Removes the full-size video once its compressed copy is saved.

outside.videos_one: {{count}} video ({{size}} GB) stored outside your recording path
outside.videos_other: {{count}} videos ({{size}} GB) stored outside your recording path
outside.hint: Move them into your recording path to keep all your content in one place.

aria.usedOfLimit: {{used}} GB used of a {{limit}} GB limit
